items.headline: U.S. Futures Mixed as Investors Assess Inflation Data and Tech Earnings
items.summary: U.S. stock futures traded on a mixed note in early hours of Thursday, August 13, following Wall Street's mixed performance on Wednesday. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite advanced, largely driven by strong earnings from AI and technology companies. Investors are now awaiting further economic data, including the Producer Price Index.

items.headline: AI-related earnings lift tech sector
items.summary: AI cloud computing company CoreWeave saw its shares jump 19% after stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings and guidance, contributing to a rally in technology stocks on Wednesday.

items.headline: Semiconductor sector strengthens
items.summary: Super Micro Computer Inc. ($SMCI) is a notable player in the semiconductor sector, which is nearing a bull market on August 13, driven by positive corporate earnings reports and robust demand for chips, particularly in AI datacenters.

items.headline: YXT.COM GROUP HOLDING suffers significant monthly decline
items.summary: YXT.COM GROUP HOLDING LIMITED has experienced a substantial monthly decline, making it one of the biggest losers in August 2026. This was announced alongside the pricing of a registered direct offering.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Expected Today: PPI and Jobless Claims
items.summary: Investors are closely watching for the release of the U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI), Initial Claims, and Continuing Claims today. The PPI, which measures wholesale prices, is expected to show a modest rise of 0.1% monthly and a year-over-year drop to 4.9% from 5.5%, which could provide further insights into inflation trends.

items.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady Amidst Mixed Signals
items.summary: The Federal Reserve maintained its overnight lending rate at 3.5%, but internal dissension points to ongoing debate over future policy amid strong job creation and persistent inflation risks. The benign July CPI report (3.4% year-over-year) has led traders to scale back bets for a September rate hike.

items.headline: AI and Tech Sector Continue to Drive Market Momentum
items.summary: The technology sector, particularly AI-related stocks and the semiconductor industry, remains a key driver of market performance. Strong earnings reports from companies in the AI supply chain have boosted investor optimism, leading to gains in indices like the Nasdaq Composite.

items.headline: Valneva and MLP SE Report Half-Year Results
items.summary: Specialty vaccine company Valneva SE ($VALN) reported its half-year 2026 financial results today, reaffirming its full-year guidance. Separately, MLP Group SE announced new record highs in both total revenue and earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) for the first half of 2026.
